label: Bible Study
verse: I and my Father are one.
note: Six words that nearly got Jesus stoned — the crowd picked up rocks in the very next verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to _____ you.
verse: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.
note: The priest's pep talk before battle: you're not fighting alone — God goes with you to save you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a _____, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
verse: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
note: A young lion roared at Samson, and he rent it as easily as a young goat — then told neither father nor mother.

label: Deep Water
prompt: (For the weapons of our warfare are not _____, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
verse: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
note: Paul's weapons aren't made of flesh — but they're strong enough to pull down fortresses.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is _____ to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verse: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
note: Why the delay? God is not 'slack' — he's 'longsuffering,' not willing that any should perish.
